h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Agra

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Agra

items.pText: Agra receives visitors from across the world because of the Taj Mahal, and many of its hotels, resorts and banquet lawns now want a play area for families who travel with children. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor playground equipment manufacturer and supplier for these sites and for Agra's schools and residential colonies. We build the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,010 km away, and send it by road for installation.

Agra's weather is hard on outdoor equipment from both sides. Summers on the Yamuna plains are extremely hot and dusty, and winter mornings bring cold and fog. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this range well, because neither rusts in the damp months and both are weather-proof. Hotels often ask us for equipment that looks good in photographs and fits the colours of the property. With 15+ roto-moulded shades and design customisation on request, we can usually match a lawn's look without building something from scratch.

richText.heading: Play areas for Agra's hotels and family resorts

items.q: Can you match playground colours to our hotel's look?
items.a: Usually, yes. Our roto-moulded parts come in 15+ shades and we offer design customisation on request. Share photos of the property and we will suggest equipment and colours that sit well with it.

items.q: How much lawn space does a small hotel play area need?
items.a: It depends on the pieces you choose, because each has its own safe play area. Send us the length and width of the lawn and we will mark a layout that fits, with space for parents to sit.

items.q: Does the equipment handle Agra's summer heat and winter fog?
items.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof and do not rust in damp winter months. In summer, place slides away from the afternoon sun so the surfaces stay comfortable to touch.
